[[File:Otgun.jpg|thumb|250px|The hydrostatic bubbles of Otoh Gunga]]
'''Hydrostatic fields''' were a type of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] shield designed to repel [[Water/Legends|water]] while allowing solid objects to pass through. As well as making up the hydrostatic bubbles of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] and other Gungan cities, hydrostatic fields were used in [[bongo]]s to sustain the passengers and crew.
